// Package router terminates HTTP for the search service.
package router

// Template is the response shape the caller is asked for. The literal is
// indented as JSON rather than as Go, which is what makes the file worth a
// fixture.
const Template = `{
  "matches": [],
  "cursor": null
}`

// Route returns the path this handler is mounted at.
func Route() string {
	return "/search"
}
